answer: In a marketplace for grove maps and opal appraisals, each identity must lock 100 credits for 30 days before earning at most 1 credit per day. The capital delta is 100 credits per extra identity, so n fakes immobilize 100n credits and incur n times the financing cost. A contract verifies an unspent deposit assigned to exactly one public key, enforces the timelock and caps daily rewards; the same bond cannot back another identity.
